$comment: A neutral starting point for a team that has not written its convention down yet. Copy it to your own file, edit it there, and have every project extend that — do not edit this one, it ships with the skill and updates will overwrite it.

convention.$comment_conforming: Add the groups your file already gets right. Every entry here is work the rename pass does not have to do.
convention.$comment_rules: Empty on purpose. Add a rule only when a transform cannot say it — see convention.transform first.
convention.$comment_structure: Loose to start with. Tighten `categories` once the top-level groups are settled; that is what turns unnameable tokens into needsReview instead of a guess.
